Today alongside launching two new products, Sonos has unveiled ‘Sonos 27’ branding for its software platform and detailed four new features coming soon for Sonos users.

Here are four new ‘Sonos 27’ features launching this fall

Sonos has launched Sonos Ace Ultra headphones today alongside a Sonos Beam Ultra soundbar. And in addition to the new hardware introductions, the company has rebranded its software.

‘Sonos 27’ is the official name of the Sonos software platform that already exists, but is getting a proper name starting today. More than just a rebrand though, Sonos announced four new software features coming this fall to Sonos users:

  • Portable surrounds
  • Personal listening
  • Sonos 27voice
  • Sonos MCP

You can find full details on these new Sonos 27 features, including specific availability and early access, on Sonos’ website.
